node.statement: Matrix-unit normalization: choose distinct minimal p,q and 0!=z in pBq as in node 1.5.2. Since z* z belongs to qBq=Cq and zz* belongs to pBp=Cp, the C*-identity gives z*z=||z||^2 q and zz*=||z||^2 p. Thus v=z/||z|| obeys v*v=q and vv*=p; also pq=0 and v=pvq imply v^2=(v*)^2=0.
